skill.summary: 导入 Apifox 导出的 OpenAPI JSON，递归展开引用，按模块分组整理并输出清晰的接口文档，支持多项目管理。

latestVersion.changelog:
v2.0.0 introduces full automation via browser automation.

- Added Playwright-based "全自动" export scripts: auto-export-playwright.js and auto-export.js
- Now supports fully automatic Apifox login, selection, export, and document generation
- Login status is persistently saved; no need to re-login each time
- Retains half-automatic/manual export as a fallback option
- Flexible project/team switching via natural language or parameters
